_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45), MAC Energy US. Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 2.3% to $91,864 while ad spend fell 40% to $34,367, so TACoS dropped from 63.7% to 37.4%.
Proper Punch led the growth (+19%), Green Apple +8%, Macberry Lychee +5%. The Variety Pack dipped 2.6% and is 43% of sales.
refunds: Refunds were $1,584 (2.5% of units), up from $1,089 the week before. Still a small share of sales; no action needed.
pacing_reco: November is $106,302 through Nov 8; at that pace the month lands near $398,631, below October's $483,507. Payout was close to break-even this week (-$3,634 vs -$42,087).
ads_context: Ad spend has fallen every week since the Oct 5–11 peak ($150,787); this week's $34,367 is the lowest in the 8-week view.
ACoS improved from 120.7% to 92.3%: ads now bring $1.08 of ad sales per $1 spent (was $0.83).
ads_strategy: Auto campaigns took $9,050 for $5,244 (172.6% ACoS); category keywords $8,809 for $5,739 (153.5%).
Branded keywords returned $6,565 on $1,275 (19.4% ACoS). Competitor targeting: $8,825 for $8,352 (105.7%).
bid_moves: Cut the Macberry Lychee auto campaign: $6,886 spent for $4,134 (166.6% ACoS), the biggest single line.
Raise budget on the Orange Creamsicle brand-exact campaign: $753 brought $5,172 (14.6% ACoS).
coupons: This week: 613 coupon orders (604 last week).
November so far: 745 coupon orders through Nov 8.
promotions: This week: 1,396 promotion orders and $17,045 in promotional discounts (vs 1,799 and $19,530 last week).
Less discounting and lower ad spend lifted payout while sales held steady.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: Variety Pack had 926 units available at FBA (Nov 2 sheet) against about 2,005 a week; 8,352 are inbound.
reviews_body: Sellerise shows a 4.5-star rating, shared across the flavors through the Variety Pack listing.
No new reviews are dated in the last 90 days, so there is no trend to read yet.
reviews_reco: Check review request settings: about 3,300 orders a week and no new reviews logged in 90 days is unusual.
Confirm review tracking covers each flavor ASIN, not only the shared listing.
recommendations: Get the 8,352 inbound Variety Pack units checked in: 926 available on Nov 2 is under half a week of sales.
Lower bids or budget on the Macberry Lychee auto campaign: $6,886 for $4,134 (166.6% ACoS).
Cut bids on “energy drink” exact targets: $3,861 spent for $2,069 in sales this week.
Move budget to brand searches: “mac energy drink” exact ran $547 for $3,554.
Pause the 54 no-sale campaign lines ($1,045 this week).
Lock BF/CM coupons and deals (Nov 27–30) around Variety Pack stock.
Load product costs into Sellerise so payout shows profit after COGS.
position: Sales held at $91,864 on 40% less ad spend; payout moved from -$42,087 to -$3,634.
TACoS is now 37.4%, down from 101.6% in the Oct 5–11 week.
